checks.details: Every task has a disposition, observed implementation, remaining scope and repository evidence paths.
No complete task acceptance was established. No terminal outcomes, removals, promotions or run checkpoints were created.
253 errors and 129 warnings; inherited cleanup remains in the existing Backlog task.
Queue IDs, priorities, statuses, provenance and dependencies remain unchanged; generated navigation and audit freshness are refreshed.

coverage_gaps: Application builds and tests were not executed. Test source inspection supplies static evidence only, with no runtime or acceptance verdict.
Browser, device, mobile usability, deployment, live Habitica, OAuth/MCP and external directory checks were not executed. No external completion is inferred from absent repository evidence.
The audit checks tracked implementation and planning contracts on develop. Ignored artifacts and undocumented external work do not establish task acceptance.
Current external API/SDK compatibility was not requalified because no integration behavior was changed.

findings.observation: Thirteen queue entries distinguish implemented foundations from remaining acceptance, including split party/quest pages, task filters/history, spell/equipment operations and static review coverage.
A fresh strict prose scan reports 253 errors and 129 warnings across 12 canonical documents; the existing cleanup task remains required.
CreateRequest still falls back to the authenticated user ID while appsettings has an empty XClientHeader; the existing identity task remains required.
